sentences.en: Creating illusions or slenderizing your body is easy when you find the right cut for your shape.

sentences.en: For the most elongating and slenderizing effect, be sure to choose dresses with vertical details, such as stripes and other embellishments that run the length of the dress.
sentences.vi: Để có hiệu ứng kéo dài và thướt tha nhất, hãy nhớ chọn váy có các chi tiết dọc, chẳng hạn như sọc và các chi tiết trang trí khác chạy theo chiều dài của váy.

sentences.en: They have the look of a sexy mini, from the front and offer slenderizing tummy control.

sentences.en: Control top plus size pantyhose offers lightweight slenderizing support with a design that includes build-in girdle support to help smooth bulges, flatten the lower stomach and lift the rear slightly.

sentences.en: A straightening iron can help flatten your bob to a more slenderizing shape while imparting a gorgeous glow on your locks.

sentences.en: You can find them at Cyberswim and shop according to your body need - elongating the torso, slenderizing the hips, supporting the bust, etc. There are many suits from which to choose.

sentences.en: The Slender Thighs, Hip Hider and Tummy Thinner bathing suits all contain slenderizing features in some of the hottest fashion colors and styles.

sentences.vi: Màu nâu có kiểu dáng đẹp như màu đen, và trông tuyệt vời trên mọi tông da.

sentences.en: Finding slenderizing bathing suits might seem like an impossible task, but you'll be happy to know that it is possible to find a suit that helps you look your svelte best.
